method: Independent review of the current frozen rewrite only. Read all 113 ordinary assigned source, tests, CI, scripts, configuration, documentation and feature-evidence files completely, rereading truncated segments. For the two large inventories, exhaustively parsed all 3111 lock lines and all capability JSON nodes, reviewed every package/resolution/metadata class and dependency edge plus all 178 method mappings, 50 unique assessments/evidence groups and 15 additional workflows. Cross-checked deployment boundaries against current tests and product documentation. Historical references were checked only for existence and SHA-256 and their report conclusions were not opened. Ran exactly two narrowly selected Python test classes under an isolated temporary home; no test discovery or aggregate runner.

validations.name: Pinned dependency inventory
validations.details: Every package has a SHA-512 integrity-only resolution; every dependency edge selects an enumerated snapshot; importer specifiers equal the current package manifest. Fixed indentation grammar rejects unrecognized shapes. All distinct engines/platform metadata reviewed against the pinned runtime and platform isolation.

validations.name: Capability inventory and evidence identity
validations.method: All JSON nodes parsed; every method and unique assessment plus every evidence group and additional workflow examined; every path/hash pair checked without reading historical report conclusions.

validations.name: Targeted lock-read and journal-schema regressions
validations.isolation: Python isolated mode and bytecode disabled; temporary HOME, USERPROFILE, CODEX_HOME and files confined to ignored round16 workspace; no native CLI, network or service invocation.

validations.name: Frozen source identity before evidence save
Root/systemd/Linux descriptor and cross-UID integration execution
validations.reason: Current host is Windows and this audit forbids deployment or SSH. Assigned Linux/root fixture source and production control paths were reviewed statically.

validations.name: Full or aggregate suites, live deployment and external service acceptance
validations.reason: Outside authorized audit scope. No full/aggregate runner, production service, external MCP, paid model, personal credentials or personal CODEX_HOME was used.

reviewedBoundaries: Archive size/link/path and metadata limits; stopped producer export; root import identity; pinned dependency downloads, lifecycle-script suppression and bounded separate online/offline build identities.
Installation preflight ownership, immutable release publication/reuse, initial-install recovery, runtime/control version boundaries, rollback journals and confirmed PID/cgroup shutdown.
Fixed sudo verbs, native/supervisor/gateway/build identity separation, root request admission/spool retention, durable operation receipts and unknown-outcome handling.

Root provider generation policy, native environment separation, host policy preservation and separate host-namespace verification; configuration-layer transaction rollback and explicit unsupported provider downgrade.
HTTPS identity/key preservation, certificate pair validation, service activity and enablement restoration, interrupted journal repair and migration boundaries.

Native workspace descriptor containment, old-version and no-replace file publication, retained recovery, sanitized Git metadata views, prepared reference/index transactions and scoped worktree bindings.

Release source scanner, snapshot exclusions, CI separation, precise test selection and three independent frozen audit gate; feature evidence accurately distinguishes scoped integration from external readiness.
limitations: No assigned inspection was skipped. Complete denotes completion of this 115-file deployment-release review, not execution of every test or the entire repository audit.
No independent Linux/root/systemd execution was performed; reviewed fixture assertions and existing feature evidence do not replace current-host live acceptance.
Historical evidence referenced by the capability inventory was hashed for identity only. Its results were not reused as current tests or earlier audit conclusions.

The lock was exhaustively reviewed with a strict parser for its observed fixed grammar, rather than a general-purpose YAML parser or a fresh package installation. External package contents and vendor supply-chain authenticity were not re-downloaded.

Capability metadata and mappings were checked exhaustively within the assigned inventory; other domain reviewers own independent full implementation review of referenced gateway/runtime/browser files.
No finding means no actionable defect was confirmed in this reviewed scope; it is not proof of absence of defects or external account/provider eligibility.
